chronicles.pausedToast: Chronicle paused (hidden from discovery; rolls may be blocked until resumed)
chronicles.title: All chronicles
chronicles.lead: Complete list from GET /api/admin/campaigns. Pause sets the chronicle inactive (players won’t see it in discovery; manual dice in that game may be blocked until you resume). Delete removes the campaign and related data — use with care.
chronicles.emptyTitle: There are no campaigns in the system.
chronicles.emptyBody: When Storytellers or players create a chronicle in the app, it appears here. If you expected something, check the database and that site admins can reach /api/admin/campaigns.
chronicles.pauseBody: “{{name}}” will be marked inactive: it disappears from discovery and join lists, and manual dice that need an active chronicle may fail until you resume it.
chronicles.pauseReason: Reason (optional, visible to staff in this list)
chronicles.pausePlaceholder: e.g. on hiatus until March, content review…
chronicles.deleteBody:
Delete “{{name}}” (id {{id}}) and all related locations, messages and data?

This cannot be undone.

membership.title: Chronicle membership — {{name}}
membership.none: None listed (no roster row and not the sole creator of an orphan chronicle).
membership.creatorOnly: (creator only — use Add below to write a roster row)
membership.noCampaigns: No chronicles in the database yet. Create one first.
membership.fallback: Full admin list unavailable (old backend?). Showing your chronicles only. Restart the backend so GET /api/admin/campaigns loads.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.multi: Multiple chronicles at once (locked sheets in more than one campaign). Without this, joining a second locked chronicle is blocked.
edit.selfSwitch: Self-switch playing character (trusted player): change which character is active in a chronicle without Storyteller approval. Other chronicles are unchanged; characters are still switched per chronicle.

ban.title: Ban {{name}}
ban.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this user is being banned…

delete.title: Delete account permanently?
delete.body:
Delete “{{name}}” and ALL of their characters?

In-character chat lines stay in the chronicle but show as posted by the system archive account (the text is unchanged). Their dice rolls may also move to that archive account. Chronicles they created are transferred to you.

unban.title: Unban user?
unban.body: They immediately regain full access to the site.

suspend.title: Suspend play — {{name}}
suspend.messagePlaceholder: Shown when they try to use this character in play.

priv.helperHint: Site-granted: multiple locked chronicles + switching the playing character without Storyteller approval
priv.multiHint: May have locked characters in more than one chronicle
priv.selfSwitchHint: May switch the active character in a chronicle without Storyteller approval

invites.title: Invite codes (sign-up)
invites.lead: Create a code and send it to the player. They enter it on the Register form with username, email and password. Invalid attempts are logged; if SMTP and MAIL_ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL are set, you get an email alert.
invites.empty: No invites yet. Create one above.

downtime.title: Character downtime requests
downtime.lead: Players send these from their profile when their sheet is locked. Approve or reject with a short reason (required for rejections).

settings.title: Local model and master prompt
settings.lmUnreachable: Is LM Studio running and reachable from the backend host?
settings.model: Chat model (OpenAI id from LM Studio)
settings.modelHint: Pick a model from the list (from GET /v1/models), or keep the default to follow whatever you load in LM Studio without pinning an id here.
settings.promptPlaceholder: Optional. Applied before each feature-specific system prompt (chat, locations, moderation…). Describe the assistant’s tone, safety rules and setting.

ai.lead: Choose which model id the backend sends to LM Studio’s OpenAI-compatible API, or leave the default to follow LM_STUDIO_MODEL in the environment and the model LM Studio reports as loaded. This is the default LM Studio model (used by the English Storyteller and fallbacks unless a role below names a model). The master system prompt is prepended to every feature-specific system prompt.

role.classifier: Classifier fallback (OOC check when Laya/Jev are not used)

key.replace: Enter a new key to replace

emb.allCurrent: All collections already use the current embedder.
emb.title: Embeddings (RAG memory)

roles.title: Models per role
roles.body: Greek messages go to the Greek Storyteller, everything else to the English one. If a cloud provider fails, the backend falls back to the local model. Leave the model empty for the default shown.

cloud.title: Cloud providers (optional)
cloud.body: Off until a key is saved and a role uses the provider. Keys are stored encrypted on the server and are never sent back to the browser; only the last 4 characters are shown.

classifier.title: Message classifier (OOC monitor + intent)
classifier.auto: Auto (Laya if installed, else LLM prompt)

moderation.title: Recent activity log
moderation.lead: Audit trail: staff actions (red), a user acting on their own account (green), automated or system events (blue). Rows stay visible when a user account was removed (names may show as missing).

security.lead: Failed sign-ins lock an account and an address for a short time. Unlock someone who is locked out below, and check the login audit when something looks wrong.
security.ipInvalid: Enter one exact IPv4 or IPv6 address (no wildcards or ranges).

unlock.title: Unlock sign-in
unlock.lead: After too many failed sign-ins the account and the address are locked for a while. Unlocking clears the failure counters and locks right away. It does not change the password and does not unban a banned user.
unlock.needOne: Enter a username, an IP address, or both.
unlock.nothing: Nothing was locked for that username or address.

audit.title: Login audit
audit.lead: Sign-ins, failures, lockouts, sign-outs and password changes, newest first. Rows are kept for 180 days. Passwords and tokens are never logged.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the login audit

home.title: Admin panel
home.lead: This area is for site administrators only. Each tab opens one tool; your changes apply to the whole site (users, invites and moderation).
home.invites: create and copy registration codes; track uses and optional notes.
home.chronicles: every campaign in the database; open one in the app to visit locations and chat (site admins only).
home.users: edit accounts, grant Helper ST privileges (multi-chronicle + self-switch PC), reset passwords, ban or unban users.
home.downtime: sheet change requests from players; approve or reject with a reason.
home.moderation: recent admin actions for audit and follow-up.
home.security: unlock an account or address after failed sign-ins; read the login audit (sign-ins, failures, lockouts, logouts).
home.ai: local model, global master prompt, model per role, cloud keys, classifier and embeddings.
